nodes.label: GET /categories/ (categories_list)
nodes.rationale: Unpaginated: a branch without its root is not a tree.

nodes.label: Category
nodes.rationale: Tree node with nested children; markup (pricing data) is not exposed since it is panel pricing data, not catalog content.

nodes.label: Collection
nodes.rationale: Listed without nested products, only productCount; nesting products would turn one navigation request into the whole catalog. Products fetched via GET /products/?collection=<slug>.

nodes.label: GET /collections/
nodes.rationale: Only collections with at least one published product.

nodes.label: Consent
nodes.rationale: Subject comes from the request (authenticated user or guest email); client never names the user explicitly, so consent cannot be recorded on behalf of someone else. Version is copied at grant time.

nodes.label: ConsentDocument
nodes.rationale: Current version per kind; newest effective version is current, earlier consents become stale.

nodes.label: PATCH /customers/profile/{id}/change-role/
nodes.rationale: Toggles role between CUSTOMER and ADMIN.

nodes.label: Gemstone
nodes.rationale: Certificate URL is time-signed because the certificate lives in private documents bucket (ADR 0025); a permanent link would be accessible to anyone who saw it once.

nodes.label: Money
nodes.rationale: Amount as integer grosze + ISO 4217 currency pair (ADR 0009), mirroring backend common.money.Money so no floating-point number appears anywhere.

nodes.label: ProductDetail
nodes.rationale: Product page with full variant list; drafts return 404 same as nonexistent products.

nodes.label: ProductImage
nodes.rationale: Model stores only keys (ADR 0025); URLs are built in the serializer since host and bucket change per environment.

nodes.label: ProductList
nodes.rationale: Product on list is represented by its cheapest variant (CONTEXT.md).

nodes.label: GET /products/ (filterable)
nodes.rationale: Only published products, each represented by cheapest variant; filters by category (incl. subcategories), collection, material, fineness, stone, size, length, metalColor, price range (grosze), search, ordering.

nodes.label: ProductVariant
nodes.rationale: Price is what the customer actually pays: manual price takes precedence over computed (ADR 0022). VAT exemption for investment gold is a separate entity, not zero rate (ADR 0013).

nodes.label: lang query parameter (i18n en/pl)
nodes.rationale: Falls back to Accept-Language header, then Polish; missing translations fall back to Polish; slug not translated.

nodes.label: Immutable English slug addressing
nodes.rationale: Resources addressed by slug not id; slug filled from name on save and cannot be changed afterward.
